notes.title: Turbo Champ has arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Turbo Champions![/h1]

Back in September 2023, Turbo Champ started as a game-jam entry. After months of designing levels, cars, and game modes- Turbo Champ is finally ready to play with your friends!

Here are a few of the exciting features that come with the game:

[h2]Campaign Mode[/h2]

For folks looking for a complete solo playthrough, "Campaign Mode" allows you to complete challenges to unlock unique cars. Those cars can be used when playing Quickplay or Tournament matches with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720540/24efffe9d96031c07d686cb29e470c086e206746.jpg[/img]

Each map has three challenges. If you do them all well, you'll get a total of 9 stars. Each time you master the challenges for a map, that unlocks a special vehicle!

[h2]Game Maps[/h2]

Turbotopia would be pretty lame if if didn't have fun maps to drive around in. Here are the five maps that you'll have access to:

[h2]🏙️ [b]Downtown[/b][/h2]

This classic map was revamped to include Police Cars and Taxi Cabs that [i]love[/i] ramming into you unexpectedly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720540/eb924af4f97aa935e10deffed9e8a33e804708f7.jpg[/img]

[h2]🌲[b]Forest[/b][/h2]

The forest map is filled with pine trees and fallen logs. Rumor has it the woods are haunted by a strange unlockable vehicle? [i]Nah[/i], that can't be right...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720540/96d7f70e4bd7123a7c532580710ce4dd79477db8.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]🏰 Castle[/h2][/b]

Nested deep with the forest is a fantasy wonderland. Navigate an angry army of skeletons as you drive through, around, and on top of the castle's walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720540/d238498b0454d68ef3170acb887b711731700fe9.jpg[/img]

[h2]🗻[b]Mountain[/b][/h2]

Beneath these snowy peaks is a vast network of mines. The place looks deserted, but some folks say that there's more than just coal coming out of those mines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720540/f549a7e9d84b892262d933f6b110ed18121af8e2.jpg[/img]

[h2]🚀[b]Space[/b][/h2]

Ah yes, we found the perfect Mars-like planet to spread human civilization to. I'm sure there won't be any alien attacks anytime soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720540/cccff144c6ecf3ffa22ae86c252c2176eb3c7711.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Game modes, hidden secrets, and more![/h2][/b]

Listen, it's 4:30am for me right now, and I've been coding for like a week straight. If you want to learn more about the new game modes, or discover the other 5 unlockable vehicles in the game, you'll have to pick up a copy for yourself.

Thanks for checking out Turbo Champ- I hope you have a great time exploring the world with your friends and loved ones.

And if you'd like to share your experience playing the game, please tag me at https://twitter.com/turbochamp_game- I'm looking forward to seeing clips and screenshots

[b]Take care, everyone![/b]
Ryan
